lines.text: The Israelites gather fasting in sackcloth with dust on their heads, then read the Book of the Law for a quarter of the day.
God chose Abram, brought him out of Ur of the Chaldeans, and made a covenant to give his descendants the land.
God divided the sea so they crossed on dry ground, and led them by a pillar of cloud by day and a pillar of salt by night.
God gave them bread from heaven when hungry and water from the river when thirsty.
The people are slaves in the land God gave their fathers, and its harvest goes to the kings set over them.
